operations.detail: Remote queue, slot state and revision 5 web files were revalidated before revision 6 writes; stale SHA conflicts were re-read rather than forced.
The legacy HMLR worker accepted any result with more than zero polygons and postcodes; revision 6 requires at least 85 percent of the selected sample.
The guarded HMLR entry uses a cache path derived from publication date and authority-link manifest hash so an earlier monthly file is not silently reused.
Selected local authorities must resolve to non-missing and non-ambiguous HMLR GML or ZIP links before heavy downloads begin.
For a 256-row sample the guarded result requires at least 218 HMLR INSPIRE polygon matches and 218 exact ONSPD postcode records.
Ofcom, ONSPD and HMLR are required probes; OS Open UPRN and ONS UPRN products are optional future-relation probes.
Five official endpoints will be checked for status, content type and source-specific signatures before large archive or GML work.
Twelve tests cover postcode normalization, authority scoring, cache versioning, missing or ambiguous link blockers and explicit no-promotion guards.
The eight existing HMLR geometry tests were added to the execution plan; total contract-test target is now 26 rather than an incorrectly declared-only count.
Six base and eight geometry tests, twelve revision 6 tests, source preflight, migration, semantic normalization, Ofcom audit and sample, ONSPD and guarded HMLR checks are serially chained.
The same attempt now targets 256 distributed Ofcom exact-postcode checks, 256 ONSPD centroid checks and 256 guarded HMLR polygon checks.
Attempt internet-access-3-20260722-001 was expanded without replay, a new runner, parallel execution or global-current-task takeover.
internet_access_3 ownership and heartbeat were renewed through 2026-07-22T06:26:20+03:00.
Web counters now show 256 prepared candidates, 26 prepared tests, five prepared source preflights and six source registry entries.
No source preflight pass, test pass, candidate revalidation, HMLR polygon result, business-row write or confidence uplift is claimed before canonical-runner recovery and remote output readback.
